items.title: 67260_Freddie Moore oral history interview
items.q: I didn't get the opportunity to meet too many of the younger drummers. Like Kenny Clarke, he was a very good drummer. And there was a drummer who was living over... I think he passed away. He was in Paris there for a while. But he wasn't necessarily a younger drummer; but he had a lot of experience.

ctx.x: Yeah. Now, he was the top drummer for all that. He was the top drummer, Max Roach. He's still living, ain't he?
